changes.title: Automatic sign-in via university single sign-on
changes.new_excerpt: the Platform may sign you in automatically. You can sign out at any time, and you will only be signed into an account
changes.explanation: The updated policy adds a new provision stating that if a user has an active single sign-on session with their university, the Platform may automatically log them in without a separate login step. It notes users can sign out and will only be signed into a pre-existing account.
changes.practical_effect: Users who are already logged into their university's single sign-on system may find themselves automatically signed into the Platform without taking any additional login action.

report.summary: The privacy policy adds a new section describing automatic sign-in through a user's university single sign-on session, noting users can sign out and will only access an existing account.
